description.text: The Department of International Foundation Courseme, Tongji University, Ministry of Education of China, is one of the six Foundation Departments for International Students under the Ministry of Education in China. The department is located on the main campus of Tongji University and owns a building of traditional Chinese style which is well equipped with advanced audio-visual labs, multimedia classrooms, multi-function classrooms, meeting rooms, and electronic reading rooms. A dormitory building was refitted and decorated for the students. More than 160 international students, supported by Chinese government scholarship, or by own expense from over 40 countries are studying at Tongji University. They will have a systematic study of general Chinese, professional Chinese, Chinese culture, cross-cultural communication, basic courses of mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology and computer science. Various language practices and social activities will also be provided. After one year's study, those who will grasp the basic knowledge of Chinese language and culture, acquiring cross-cultural communication skills and a certain amount of specialized vocabulary and knowledge, which will help them meet the requirements of their further studies and daily life in universities of China. Meanwhile, the students graduate from the Courseme will obtain the certificate approved by the Ministry of Education of China. duration.text: The International Foundation Program at Tongji University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2687 USD/per semester ￥ 19350 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.The guardian shall provide the following personal materials :1. The guardian is a Chinese citizen: resident ID card; Bank deposit certificate (the amount is not less than RMB 100,000 yuan, and the deadline must be greater than January 31 of the following year); Guardian Guarantee (please click to download). 2. Guardian is a foreign citizen: copy of passport (information page); Non-student residence permit (valid later than January 31 of the second year of application); Bank deposit certificate (the amount is not less than RMB 100,000 yuan, and the deadline must be greater than January 31 of the following year); Guardian bond.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be between the age of 18 to 65 years old.2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport.3.(Applicants must) Be in good health.4. High school graduate or equivalent or above.5. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university;6. Record of good conduct7. All language levels are available8. Applicant who is under 18 years old needs to submit the guardian's guarantee
